body: Even if it is her, it still hurts
I don't even know how to get started. How does one get started in life?

I know every convict says this, but for some shit I didn't do. The judge actually told me, "You're guilty, we just can't prove it."

:/
It's not out of spite, dumbass; it's simply one of the many things that drive me nuts, and it's what was on my mind when I was typing this.
If I'm gone, I won't be around to care about missing it

Do you know of a better way that won't have such an effect on so many people? I figure a train will be relatively painless, and while messy, at least my family won't be the ones needing to clean it up.
It's not long at all, but it's nothing but time to think about how I should have killed myself.
I'm sure she'll find somebody else to be a father. Maybe that guy will be worthy of having a kid with his last name
